speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Mage Squadron, this is the situation.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Golem and the other base's squadrons already joined forces and are engaged.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: You guys will arrive right in the middle of the action.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Mage Squadron, eliminate all bandits in the current airspace.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: We have the upper hand, but that doesn't mean we can ease up. Good luck.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Mage 1 to Golem 1. Thank your lucky stars.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Looking good, Mage Squadron. Keep up that pressure.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Trigger, time to show the other guys that we get wet, wild, and do dirty, dirty things.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text:
Once you hit one of them, stick to 'em like glue.
Don't let them out of your sights, even in the clouds.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: And so your first hunting season begins.

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Enemy reinforcements. I don't like these odds.

speaker: Skeleton Squadron
text: Don't let those jerks steal your kills!

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Careful. There's a real demon in there.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: If you can't evade a missile, use chaff and flares.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Your fingers should still move, even if you're in a 9G turn.

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text:
We're getting our asses kicked.
Where are our reinforcements?!

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Bandit in my sights! Locked on!

speaker: Golem 3 Boggard
text: Let's do the humane thing and put 'em down!

speaker: Skeleton Squadron
text: I'm under fire in the clouds!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: You're mine! I'll make it quick!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: I've got him in my sights.

speaker: Skeleton Squadron
text: We've got this. They can't recover.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Our radar shows no sign of bandits. You're in the clear.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: I haven't even broken a sweat.

speaker: Skeleton Squadron
text:
They have to be crazy to pick a fight with us!
A rabid dog would know better!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text:
Caution! A large aircraft is approaching!
All aircraft, stay alert!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text:
We've just learned that Erusea is
utilizing the Arsenal Bird.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Those bastards. They had that thing combat-ready this whole time.

speaker: Skeleton Squadron
text:
Sky Keeper, this is Skeleton 1.
What do we do about that monster?

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: We're just waiting for mission command.

speaker: Skeleton Squadron
text: I've a bad feeling about this.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: These guys are definitely a step above the last drones.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: Damn, they're agile. And there's too many of them.

speaker: Golem 4 Footpad
text: These guys won't go down easy.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: All aircraft, no change in game plan.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: We're up against that thing? God help us.

speaker: Skeleton Squadron
text: It's hard enough just keeping up with the drones.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Golem Squadron, take out big Baby Huey!

speaker: Skeleton Squadron
text: Look at that light from the Arsenal Bird!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: I've got him in my sights.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text:
Gargoyle Squadron, this is Gargoyle 1.
Skeleton Squadron needs help.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: The hell are we supposed to do?!

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text:
I can't get a read on these bandits.
They're dodging everything I throw at 'em.

speaker: Golem 3 Boggard
text: This is Golem 3. Golem 2 is hit!

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text:
This is Golem 2.
Instruments still appear to be functioning okay.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: They just keep coming! What's the plan?

speaker: IUN-PKF HQ
text: Sky Keeper, I repeat, maintain air superiority.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Skeleton Squadron is down. We've had too many losses.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: All squadrons, command has ordered a complete withdrawal. Leave the operation area immediately.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: Brilliant observation! If they'd noticed earlier, more of us would've survived to hear it!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Save your chatter for the debriefing.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Give our allies some time to escape.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text:
Wilco. But Golem 2's hit.
Gotta send 'er back.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Shoot down those UAVs! Don't let them touch any friendlies.

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: Continuing the mission. Still got my wings.

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: Trigger doesn't need to fill in for me. I'm back, an

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: You won't make any difference up here. Get back to base and cool your head.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text:
The longer it takes,
the worse our odds of getting out here are.
Machines don't get tired.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Thatta boy, Mage 2. Just keep firing.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Retreating aircraft, leave the AO. Allies will hold off pursuit.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text:
Golem Squadron, Mage Squadron,
hang in there and come back safe.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Mage Squadron, you're going toe to toe with the UAVs. Good work.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: More UAVs spotted! Gargoyle Squadron, they might cut off your retreat!

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: This is Gargoyle 1. Leaving operation airspace with Golem 2.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Retreating aircrafts, prepare for combat! It's a bogey!

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: I can't shake it off. It's matching me move for move!

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: Golem and Mage Squadrons! Help us!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Get those UAVs off of friends!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: An ally's hit! Golem and Mage, move in to provide support!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Mage 2, enemy has a lock on you!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: That's it, Trigger! They're machines. Don't show 'em any mercy.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Target is in range of guns!

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: Mage Squadron! Get those things off my ass!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: I'm tied up now! Trigger, can you help 'em?!

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text:
Let Golem and Mage Squadrons handle it.
They'll pull through.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text:
Does Mage Squadron still have their hotshot?
Then we just might make it out.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: Don't look back. Just have faith.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: Golem and Mage, we owe you a debt, and we'll pay it.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: It's got a lock on me!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Mage 2, move to support. Other aircraft are in trouble.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: A few seconds could mean life or death for 'em. Hurry up.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: I know. All we can do is fly away as fast as we can.

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: I don't get it. Why isn't it opening fire?

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Mage 2, UAV down. Keep it up, buddy.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: Fort Grays aircraft, we'll let you take it easy next time.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Mage 2, provide cover for allied retreat.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: Damn it! I can't break away!

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: Mage 2 is taking on multiple UAVs!

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: He's got them at bay. We owe him one.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Target is in range of guns!

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: How can I retreat with a UAV on my tail!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Distract the bandit! Buy our friends some time!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text:
Hell of a good job, Mage 2.
We want as many guys out here as possible.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Golem 2, get a hold of yourself!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Golem 2, get away from the enemy!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Sky Keeper, where's the one that got Brownie?

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Afraid he's long gone by now.

speaker: Gargoyle Squadron
text: I can't pull out of this furball!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Retreating ally has been shot down! Damn it, we can't cover them in this fubar!
